svg.title: Big Tex: Rewired — innocent bystanders
svg.desc: Twelve original cut-paper characters: fairgoers, a family, a stroller parent, a vendor, and people reacting to the giant cowboy.

g.text: THEY JUST CAME FOR THE FAIR.
